verdict.rationale: Windmill's flow docs describe branches that split execution on a condition, plus a "branch all" mode that executes every branch. These are built in the low-code flow builder (or YAML), and the workflows-as-code docs say Windmill handles parallelism. That covers the core of conditional and multi-path branching, but the evidence does not explicitly cover filtering or results merging back after the branches. Missing for 10: explicit filter step evidence, documentation that branch outputs merge back into a single downstream step, explicit confirmation that branch-all runs in parallel in the visual builder, independent hands-on corroboration.
